fields.statement: At 3b97350, go test ./internal/api -run TestProgramStatus -count=1 -v passes. TestProgramStatusReviewQuestions has check alpha record finding f1 in every cycle, so the review goes through fixer attempts 2 and 3 (its two fix cycles) and check cycle 3. Rex reports go to a buffer standing in for Rex. The last report is the root record (no id) with state=blocked and msg "Status runs: step review waits on you: Review check alpha still fails after 3 cycles: finding f1 (major): bad f1. ...". That names the change set by its title (rexRoot falls back to the change ID), the review step and the question's text. In the diff, deriveStatus maps a failed run whose ending step's detail lists unanswered questions to StatusBlocked, and the journal now keeps the question text in Detail. make check exits 0.
